title: His and her endings: choosing -nsa or -nsä
focus: Choose the third-person suffix vowel from back, front, and neutral-only noun bases.

exercises.prompt: Choose the Finnish noun phrase “his car”. Use hänen and auto (“car”).
exercises.explanation: Hänen selects -nsa: auto + -nsa = autonsa. Back a/o/u chooses -nsa; front vowels or only e/i choose -nsä.
exercises.misconceptionCategory: Third-person possessive vowel harmony: form or meaning confused
